critical_code_review_comments: server.py _JOB_DEFS is a single source-of-truth tuple list with exactly 14+12+12+12=50 entries; _make_seed_job generates deterministic phone/distance/posted_minutes via index math (good for snapshot stability).
list_jobs bucket compare uses .lower() on both sides — case-insensitive as advertised; ?bucket=Garbage falls through and returns [] (no 4xx, consistent with 'unknown bucket = no matches').
Job pydantic model now has 'bucket: str' required — every seed row populates it, no None leaks. Frontend Job type mirrors this.

jobs.tsx filteredJobs is client-side derived (jobs.filter(j=>j.bucket===bucket)) — server-side bucket param is optional, frontend never sends it. Both paths render identical counts. Acceptable but slightly redundant; main agent may opt to drive via server param in future.
Chip row is OUTSIDE the inner ScrollView so it's structurally sticky without needing stickyHeaderIndices — height fixed at 56px with horizontal-only inner ScrollView (no wrap).
